pages.text: Catch a fish with a Fiery, Permafrost or Twilight Hook fitted.

pages.title: A Hook Changes the Forecast
pages.text: Change fishing conditions through actual tackle.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: These hooks change water temperature or fish time preferences; lines help with fish movement and catch difficulty. Native fishing decides eligibility.

pages.title: Equip fishing bait
pages.text: Fit bait through the rod's supported inventory interaction. Different baits change speed or special behavior rather than serving as a currency.

pages.title: Customize a rod
pages.text: An Angling Table changes the rod's supported accessories. Install the part in its real slot instead of merely carrying it.

pages.title: Choose a specialized fishing rod
pages.text: Crystal Rods signal bites with sound; Echo helps identify a hooked fish; Diamond changes experience. Weather and light rods have their own conditions, while Midas and Village rods offer separate bonus finds.

pages.title: Change fishing access with a hook
pages.text: Lavaproof and Depths hooks open environments. Fiery and Permafrost change temperature; Twilight changes timing. Lines influence fish movement and catch difficulty.
